test_title: PYST 5: SSC Stenographer - Reasoning (Held On:13 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Point A is 35 m to the east of Point B. Point C is 28 m to the south of Point B. Point C is 15 m to the east of Point D. Point E is 14 m to the north of Point D. Point F is 20 m to the east of Point E. In which direction is Point A with respect to Point F?
solution:
According to the given information,

1) Point A is 35 m to the east of Point B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bc938d0d9a8e5332207a47365816bc3ca35eca169f80197a65a65398c29888a2.png] 

2) Point C is 28 m to the south of Point B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c3a3ab4f6911b93e53662d16ebc99b42406fd7c63a95f1a3cc9b17571f7efbec.png] 

3) Point C is 15 m to the east of Point D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/947a0c081f4ec36663d2268859dde51e08d23aa5fbe7cb0472f1f4a5f19ae785.png] 

4) Point E is 14 m to the north of Point D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/df9ff3cc54110550a69812547798a13809392060e190fdbf699b2e7d444075c6.png] 

5) Point F is 20 m to the east of Point E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3426c4b2111de1ccf9a8223878b76e5f2e3deb4e56d1594e1c324019a5c58ac9.png] 

Here, we can see that Point A is in North-east direction of Point F.

Hence, the correct answer is **"North-east".**
